probe.direction: Reconstructs what the record actually holds for this transformation and cites each note it used: the Suzuki biaryl run (its base, solvent system, temperature, degassing and isolated yield), the aqueous-protodeboronation failure mode, and the degassing / Pd cross-coupling scope playbooks.
